description:
Embedded Linux Software Development Engineer

Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you’re interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Description

As an Embedded Linux Software Development Engineer BSP, you are part of the R&D team, making sure our Linux BSPs and related software offerings for our SoMs (System on Modules) are constantly developed, maintained, and quality improved. The work ranges from initial bring-up, to driver and kernel development, up to build-system, tooling and distro level development.

  • Develop and maintain Embedded Linux BSPs for Toradex' embedded computer modules
  • Eco-system: porting of third party software libraries, develop Software tools and utilities from scratch, Boot loader firmware
  • Mainline selected items
  • Suggest improvements related to products, software offerings, documentation, processes, etc. in order to allow continuous improvement
  • Work closely with other team members in an Agile development environment and participate in technical analysis and decisions
  • Communicate your work progress, coordinate with other development teams, and participate in R&D working groups

Skills

  • Expertise in Embedded Linux: Bootloader and Linux Kernel
  • Excellent C language knowledge and programming skills
  • Knowing OpenEmbedded/Yocto Project build system
  • Knowledge of industry standard interfaces and protocols such as I2C , SPI , UART , USB, Ethernet, PCI Express
  • C++/Python/Bash language knowledge and programming skills
  • Demonstrable Electronics knowledge and work experience: the ability to read and understand hardware schematics and datasheets; to use standard development aids such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, bus protocol analyzers, etc. when developing low-level software which interacts directly with machine registers
  • Familiar with communication peripherals (Bluetooth, Ethernet, Wi-Fi)
  • High-integrity, open, team player

Plus but NOT MANDATORY:

  • Experience with Real Time Operating systems
  • Knowledge of the ARM architecture

What do we offer

  • Agile, globally oriented and inter-cultural corporate culture.
  • Flexible working set up. Working remotely possible (within European time zone)
  • Work on the latest HW technology with early access to major SoC vendor
  • Enjoy a flat hierarchy where you may truly shape our HW and SW offerings
  • Count on a diverse team of experienced HW and SW engineers
  • Variety of knowledge sharing, training and self-development opportunities
  • The opportunity to play a key role in shaping your own work processes and your work environment.
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment.
  • Opportunities for your personal development.
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Todradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

Marex Group plc (NASDAQ: MRX) is a diversified global financial services platform providing essential liquidity, market access and infrastructure services to clients across energy, commodities and financial markets. Graduação nos cursos de Farmácia, Química ou correlatas preferencialmente;

Sólida experiência em laboratórios de controle de qualidade de indústria farmacêutica/veterinária preferencialmente;

Inglês intermediário imprescindível, avançado é desejável.

  3. Conhecimento técnico (teórico e prático) em técnicas convencionais como titulação, espectrofotometria, dentre outras aplicadas à análises de Produto Acabado e matéria-prima;
  4. Possuir sólidos conhecimentos nas técnicas de HPLC e GC;

title: Inside Sales
description:
Posição estratégica no time de Planejamento Comercial, com responsabilidade direta sobre a análise de mercado e performance para apoiar a expansão da rede de franquias. O profissional atuará com foco em dados e inteligência territorial, sendo responsável por identificar oportunidades de crescimento , priorizar praças com alto potencial e suportar a liderança comercial na definição de metas e ações regionais .

A atuação envolve o uso de ferramentas modernas de segmentação e priorização territorial , cruzando dados internos (performance de unidades, captação, conversão, entre outros) com dados externos (perfil demográfico, concorrência, indicadores econômicos), garantindo decisões estratégicas baseadas em dados e otimizando os esforços de crescimento da marca.

Este profissional também terá papel importante na estruturação e sustentação do funil de expansão , qualificando potenciais investidores, e colaborando com áreas-chave como Expansão, Marketing e Franquias para direcionamento das ações.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Realizar análises de mercado e inteligência territorial para identificar e priorizar regiões com maior potencial de expansão;
  • Desenvolver e aplicar modelos de priorização estratégica de praças e unidades , considerando potencial de mercado, maturidade da operação e performance comercial;
  • Mapear e qualificar oportunidades de novos franqueados, apoiando o funil de expansão com inteligência de dados e perfil de investidor;
  • Acompanhar e interpretar indicadores de performance das unidades franqueadas, gerando relatórios e insights que apoiem decisões comerciais;
  • Apoiar o processo de construção e desdobramento de metas comerciais, garantindo alinhamento com o contexto territorial e o plano de expansão;
  • Criar e manter dashboards e relatórios gerenciais para dar visibilidade aos stakeholders e facilitar o acompanhamento do plano de crescimento;
  • Colaborar com áreas como Expansão, Marketing e Gestão de Franquias no desenvolvimento de ações direcionadas por dados;
  • Monitorar tendências do setor de franquias, comportamento de consumo e dados externos relevantes para antecipar riscos e oportunidades;
  • Manter bases de dados organizadas e confiáveis, assegurando a integridade das informações utilizadas em análises e tomadas de decisão.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com inteligência comercial, expansão de franquias, planejamento de mercado ou áreas correlatas, preferencialmente em ambientes com atuação nacional;
  • Domínio de ferramentas analíticas e de visualização de dados, como Excel avançado, Power BI, Google Looker Studio, entre outros;
  • Conhecimento em geoanálise, segmentação territorial e análise de potencial de mercado (desejável experiência com mapas, clusterização ou ferramentas de geolocalização);
  • Capacidade de interpretar dados complexos e transformá-los em recomendações práticas e estratégicas para as áreas de negócio;
  • Familiaridade com indicadores comerciais (captação, conversão, ticket médio, churn, etc.) e leitura de performance por canal/unidade;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar com grandes bases de dados e realizar cruzamentos com fontes externas (IBGE, ABF, concorrência, etc.);
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade para apresentar análises e conduzir alinhamentos com diferentes níveis hierárquicos;
  • Perfil organizado, proativo, com senso crítico, visão estratégica e foco em resultado;
  • Formação em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Estatística, Marketing ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou especialização será considerada um diferencial.

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

As the Product Manager of the Fintech Experience team, you will be responsible for running discovery processes to identify solutions that improve the user journey, producing clear documentation, and managing results. You will also be in charge of communicating with business stakeholders. Mastery of agile methodologies and management tools such as Confluence and Jira is essential for this role.

A deep understanding of financial business processes, such as credit and digital payments, along with extensive experience in global implementations, is highly desirable.

Excellent interpersonal skills are a must, including clear and didactic communication across both vertical and horizontal leadership, flexibility, teamwork, and experience dealing with multiple stakeholders. Proficiency in English for daily interactions with the team and for delivering presentations is also essential.

  • Define success metrics for features or services and monitor their performance;
  • Understand complex problems across business units, geographies, and product lines. Formulate hypotheses and translate them into requirements, identifying meaningful insights to guide product development;
  • Create roadmaps based on relevant requirements and dependencies, ensuring alignment with commercial and strategic objectives.

What you\'ll need:

  • University degree in any area.
  • 4+ years of work experience in Product area, such as a Product Manager or Product Owner;
  • Experience with front and backend development teams;
  • Experience in Fintech environments, such as Digital Payments or Credit operations;
  • Experience proposing product evolutions focused on user experience;
  • Advance knowledge in Scrum and day to day development workflows;
  • Experience using Jira, Segment, Mix Panel, Databricks, or similar tools;
  • Advanced communication and presentation skills in English.

More about you:

  • You\'re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You\'re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;

WHY JOIN US

ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Product Manager , you’ll define strategy, lead teams, and deliver digital products that engage millions of users worldwide. Combining data-driven insights with market knowledge, you’ll shape product vision, mentor peers, and collaborate across functions. This role offers high impact, growth, and the chance to influence the future of digital media .

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Product Strategy – Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and vision for IGN’s digital platforms and products, aligning it with the company’s goals and objectives
  • Product Leadership – Lead multiple product teams and drive product strategy for a larger portfolio of products.
  • Team Leadership – Lead and mentor a team of product managers, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals and deliver high-quality products.
  • Product Roadmap – Define and maintain the product roadmap for multiple products, ensuring it aligns with business priorities, user needs, and market trends. Make data-driven decisions and prioritize features accordingly.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, editorial, and marketing, to ensure successful product development and delivery.

  • Data Analysis – Utilize data analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions to optimize the product.
  • Product Development – Oversee the end-to-end product development process, from ideation to release. Coordinate with development teams to deliver high-quality products on schedule.
  • Project Management – Define and prioritize product features, enhancements, and requirements based on customer feedback, market research, and business impact. Collaborate with product managers to ensure that product feature prioritization aligns with the overall product strategy and roadmap.
  • Product Launch – Plan and execute successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post-launch and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals.

- Demonstrated ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using sound judgment to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well-structured, data-informed, written narrative;
- Proven ability to engage with engineers, designers, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship;

- Upper-Intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Deep understanding of gaming trends;
- Strong background in app development and design.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
Overview

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We are scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform how food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils to create a liveable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We are partnering with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders and are growing fast. Our culture blends people-first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

We are proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil where the real climate impact happens.

About The Role

Role: COO to lead go-to-market strategy for novel mineral-based carbon removal products across agricultural and mining sectors, and to evolve our operational backbone. You will oversee the entire value chain—from mineral inputs and field operations to the internal science engine and technology roadmap. This is a senior role where bold strategy meets operational precision to drive transformational scale.

Location & Travel: Hybrid, with travel in Brazil. Language skills: Portuguese, English (fluent). Start date: Ideally Q3/Q4 2025.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and scale a novel carbon removal product from early traction to national impact in agriculture and mining; a 1-100 leadership role requiring bold strategy and relentless execution.
  • Lead the design and execution of a world-class ERW deployment operation across Brazil with scalability in mind.
  • Translate carbon and climate goals into clear operational strategies and regional delivery models.
  • Drive continuous improvement via operational KPIs, systemisation, and data-driven performance.
  • Collaborate with the Chief Impact Officer, Head of Operations, and VP of Science to align field strategy with scientific standards and operational goals.
  • Lead the integration of field deployment, scientific integrity, and operational scaling to ensure product-market fit.
  • Build cross-functional alignment to ensure the product offers agronomic value while meeting carbon certification requirements; orchestrate the 1-100 scale-up journey.
  • Oversee the sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder from mine to farm; ensure compliance with carbon standards and farmer requirements.
  • Support legal to uphold integrity in carbon reporting and environmental impact.
  • Lead a large and growing team across Brazil and globally; collaborate with Carbon, Science, and Technology teams and strategic partners.

Team & Culture

  • Build a leadership culture that is entrepreneurial, fast, and accountable; turn high performers into high-impact owners.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing operations teams across Brazil and globally.
  • Champion a culture of accountability, collaboration, and impact-driven execution.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads to deliver quality projects at scale.

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of senior leadership in operations, supply chain, or agribusiness in Brazil and in high-growth or startup contexts.
  • You have scaled something from messy beginnings to market success—ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO. You know what product-market fit looks like, and how to turn it into category leadership.
  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building scalable systems from the ground up.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills in Portuguese and English.

Key Qualities

  • Visionary but pragmatic—able to balance long-term strategy with daily urgency.
  • A confident, emotionally intelligent leader who knows when to listen, act, and delegate.
  • Comfortable navigating complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, and willing to “get your boots dirty” when needed.
  • Passion for sustainability, tropical agriculture, and climate innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in impact-driven sectors such as climate, carbon markets, or regenerative agriculture is a big plus.
  • Deep knowledge and network of Brazilian agriculture, logistics, or mining.
  • Experience building strategic and commercial partnerships in Brazil, within agriculture.
  • Experience with building and scaling tech for agriculture.

Living Our Values

  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering trust and collaboration.
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency.
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our mission to address climate change.
  • Compensation: Competitive compensation philosophy discussed in the first interview to manage expectations fairly.
  • Share options to make you feel like an owner.
  • Home Office Budget; Hybrid Remote around Sao Paulo.
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance.
  • 40 days annual leave.
  • The opportunity to be autonomous and belong to a vision.
  • Bi-annual offsites in Brazil.
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity.

Application Process

Roughly 8 hours across 4-6 weeks from CV-screening.

  • Interview with VP of People
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  • 1-2 more 1:1 interviews with core leaders
  • Panel with 4+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)
  • Verbal reference check and psychometric profiling
  • Offer

How To Apply

  • Submit your CV in English, as this is the main language used at InPlanet (Portuguese accepted if justified).

Being an equal opportunity employer, InPlanet does not discriminate on grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race. We design our processes to be fair and equitable and believe in continuous learning.

description:
Aeroporto de Viracopos (VCP)!
Responsibilities and assignments

Job Description
Venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no país! ️
A dnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, garantindo que todos os voos recebam o melhor atendimento com o máximo de agilidade; nossas equipes são reconhecidas pela dedicação, profissionalismo, ética, qualidade e expertise apresentados; somos 100% dedicados ao cumprimento de nossas funções.
Globalmente, a dnata foi fundada em 1959 em Dubai, possui mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes.
O Operador de Equipamentos ficará responsável por realizar a operação de atendimento de rampa (movimentação de equipamentos motorizados ou não, embarque e desembarque de passageiros cadeirantes, transporte de bagagens e cargas entre as áreas operacionais do aeroporto) em aeronaves com segurança, qualidade e pontualidade, garantindo eficiência no processo e colaborando para a construção da percepção do cliente quanto aos serviços prestados pela empresa no que tange ao transporte de bagagens, cargas e pontualidade dos voos.
Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para o Aeroporto de Viracopos (VCP)!
Responsibilities and assignments

  • Operar os equipamentos de rampa, realizando a movimentação segura de equipamentos rebocáveis no que tange a logística de preparação de box para atendimento dos voos com equipamentos necessários de acordo com a disponibilidade, levando-se em consideração o load fator, turnaroud da aeronave, distribuição de cargas e bagagens nos porões;
  • Disponibilizar os equipamentos de GPU, ACU e LPU sempre que a aeronave estiver com APU inoperante e/ou para a execução do projeto smart fuel;
  • Realizar o transporte de bagagem e cargas entre variadas áreas de cada aeroporto que estão embarcando, desembarcando ou em conexão;
  • Garantir a segurança de todos durante o atendimento operacional;
  • Garantir a transferência das bagagens de conexão imediata (HOT), para as outas aeronaves;
  • Recolher os equipamentos do box após o termino do atendimento.
Requirements And Qualifications
  • Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) tipo D/E.
  • Visão analítica e sistemática, para tomadas de decisões;
  • Disponibilidade de horário;
  • Conhecimento em processo de atendimento ao cliente;
Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura variável para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico, locomoção e deambulação para desenvolvimento das tarefas.
Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para condução dos veículos (atividade regulamentada pelo CTB – código de trânsito brasileiro) e percepção auditiva para detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais.
Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

DESCRIÇÃO
Dentista Avaliador(a) (Banco de Talentos)

Você é dentista, ama cuidar de pessoas, mas também vibra com metas, desafios e realizações?

Então vem com a gente transformar sorrisos e resultados!

Na Odontoclinic, procuramos Dentistas Avaliadores(as) com olhar clínico e espírito comercial. Profissionais que sabem encantar no atendimento e têm paixão por entregar experiências únicas e gerar valor em cada conversa com o paciente.

O Que Você Vai Encontrar Aqui

  • Um ambiente acolhedor, colaborativo e com alto astral
  • Treinamentos constantes e ferramentas para o seu desenvolvimento
  • Reconhecimento por desempenho e oportunidades reais de crescimento
  • Remuneração atrativa com base em meritocracia
  • Propósito: transformar a vida das pessoas através do sorriso!

Procuramos Alguém Com

  • Formação em Odontologia com CRO ativo
  • Comunicação empática, segura e persuasiva
  • Facilidade para construir conexão e gerar confiança com o paciente
  • Capacidade de apresentar planos de tratamento de forma clara e estratégica
  • Energia, foco em metas e atitude de dono(a)
  • Vivência com vendas será um diferencial, mas vontade de aprender conta muito!

Suas Principais Missões

  • Realizar avaliações iniciais com excelência e atenção genuína
  • Apresentar planos de tratamento alinhados às necessidades do paciente
  • Trabalhar de forma próxima com a equipe para atingir metas e gerar encantamento
  • Ser um elo entre o cuidado clínico e o sucesso do paciente na jornada odontológica

Se você acredita que excelência clínica e performance podem andar juntas, essa é a sua chance de fazer parte de algo grandioso.

Vem ser Odontocliniquer e crescer com a gente!

Sobre a ODONTOCLINIC

Na Odontoclinic, somos movidos por pessoas e por sorrisos.

Somos uma empresa feita de gente que gosta de gente. Aqui, acreditamos no poder da atitude, da ação e da paixão por encantar. Nosso time é formado por profissionais que não apenas vestem a camisa, mas têm atitude de dono, colocam a mão na massa e fazem acontecer todos os dias.

Com mais de 28 anos de história, construímos a maior rede de franquias odontológicas do Brasil. São mais de 180 clínicas em todo o país, mais de 1 milhão de sorrisos cuidados com carinho e cerca de 9 mil atendimentos realizados por dia. Tudo isso só é possível porque temos um time incrível por trás de cada resultado.

Somos a primeira rede de franquias odontológicas do país e, ao longo dos anos, colecionamos conquistas como o Troféu Excelência em Franchising da ABF e o reconhecimento como uma das Melhores Franquias do Brasil pela revista Pequenas Empresas & Grandes Negócios. Também fomos eleitos, por seis anos consecutivos, como a clínica com o melhor atendimento do Brasil no segmento odontológico pelo Reclame Aqui — um reflexo direto da nossa paixão por servir e do compromisso com a qualidade em cada detalhe.

Aqui, acreditamos que o desenvolvimento de pessoas é o caminho para construir resultados sustentáveis. Por isso, investimos constantemente em treinamentos, programas de capacitação e iniciativas que potencializam o crescimento pessoal e profissional dos nossos colaboradores. Acreditamos no poder da educação continuada como alicerce para inovação, performance e encantamento.

Na Odontoclinic, você encontra um ambiente acolhedor, diverso e cheio de oportunidades. Um lugar onde você pode ser quem é, crescer, aprender e deixar sua marca. Se você tem espírito empreendedor, gosta de desafios e quer fazer parte de algo grande, seu lugar é aqui.

Se você acredita que excelência clínica e performance podem andar juntas, essa é a sua chance de fazer parte de algo grandioso. Vem ser Odontocliniquer e crescer com a gente!

Sobre a Odontoclinic

Na Odontoclinic, somos movidos por pessoas e por sorrisos. Somos uma empresa feita de gente que gosta de gente. Aqui, acreditamos no poder da atitude, da ação e da paixão por encantar. Nosso time é formado por profissionais que não apenas vestem a camisa, mas têm atitude de dono, colocam a mão na massa e fazem acontecer todos os dias.

Com mais de 28 anos de história, construímos a maior rede de franquias odontológicas do Brasil. São mais de 180 clínicas em todo o país, mais de 1 milhão de sorrisos cuidados com carinho e cerca de 9 mil atendimentos realizados por dia. Aqui, acreditamos que o desenvolvimento de pessoas é o caminho para construir resultados sustentáveis. Por isso, investimos constantemente em treinamentos, programas de capacitação e iniciativas que potencializam o crescimento pessoal e profissional dos nossos colaboradores. Acreditamos no poder da educação continuada como alicerce para inovação, performance e encantamento.

Na Odontoclinic, você encontra um ambiente acolhedor, diverso e cheio de oportunidades. Um lugar onde você pode ser quem é, crescer, aprender e deixar sua marca. Se você tem espírito empreendedor, gosta de desafios e quer fazer parte de algo grande, seu lugar é aqui.

title: Upstream Bioprocess Scale-up Engineer Specialist
description:
Overview

Braskem, a global leader in the production of bio-based materials, is committed to reducing the carbon intensity of its products through development of technology utilizing bio-based feedstocks. In addition to its existing biotechnology research center in Campinas, Brazil, Braskem has recently opened a new renewable research and development facility in Lexington, MA. These two state-of-the-art facilities bring together scientists and engineers from a variety of disciplines to ideate and develop novel technologies for the production of bio-based chemicals and materials.

Role Description

Braskem Innovation and Technology is seeking an exceptional upstream bioprocess engineer for to scale-up of emerging technologies in the area of bio-based chemicals via fermentation processes. The candidate will work closely with the fermentation development team and have primary responsibility for commercial process design, ensuring technical risks are addressed and mitigated in the scale-up from lab to pilot/demo phases. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in fermentation scale-up with experience in implementation of new technology at industrial scale and comfort working closely with innovative teams from research and development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Synthesize the upstream conceptual process design for fermentation-based technologies emerging from discovery teams in lab. This includes all steps from feed preparation, seed train, and fermentation sections of the flowsheet.
  • Work closely with the fermentation development team to guide experimental work with a view toward the commercial process design, and ensure relevant technical targets are set based on commercial process economics.
  • Guide the planning of the pilot plant testing program according to the conceptualized commercial design to ensure the key risks are mapped and mitigate as the technology progresses through scale-up.
  • Build strong relationships while working closely with the firms operating or constructing the pilot plant fermentation units.
  • Generate the technology transfer package in collaboration with the fermentation development team for upstream section of the bioprocess. Serve as the fermentation process expert during pilot and demo testing, being present onsite for extended campaigns.
  • Support process safety reviews for emerging technologies.
  • Own responsibility as the expert on the process technology and key deliverables of the Process Design Package PDP that will be the basis for commercial design and engineering or toll manufacturing.

Additional Responsibilities and Activities

  • Identify and evaluate innovative and disruptive technologies through interaction with technology licensors, participation in events associated with bio-based chemical technologies, and review of international publications.
  • Carry out techno-economic assessments, actively participating in the preparation and/or technical review of mass and energy balances, PFDs, Capex and Opex estimates, among others.
  • Work with different teams within Braskem (eg process engineering, biotech and catalysis, sustainability, innovation, intellectual property, etc.) to guarantee the successful development of projects.
  • Collaborate with universities, start-ups and technology hubs seeking new technologies that may be of interest to Braskem.

Requirements

  • B S in Chemical Engineering or relevant field (PhD is a plus) with a strong background in new technology development
  • 10+ years (including graduate research) experience in bioprocess engineering
  • Demonstrated experience in process development and scale-up for fermentation technology with implementation of new technology at industrial scale
  • Demonstrated expertise using process simulation software (eg SuperPro or Aspen Plus)
  • Experience in pilot plant and/or demo plant operations
  • Experience with microbial, aseptic aerobic fermentation in stainless steel SIP fermenters
  • Strong technical judgement to assess project decisions and timetables
  • Ability and seniority to ensure good interpersonal relationships and people management, to work on projects with internal and external interfaces
  • Have a working knowledge of intellectual property
  • English and Portuguese fluency is required

Location: Hybrid mode with a home site of Campinas, Brazil to ensure a close working relationship with research teams at the Braskem Tech Centers.

Job details

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Job function: Engineering and Information Technology
  • Industries: Plastics Manufacturing

  • Contribuir diretamente para o aumento da produtividade e da assertividade dos engenheiros, através da criação e implementação de padrões, procedimentos e ferramentas de engenharia.

  • Otimizar o tempo de execução das tarefas de engenharia, permitindo que os engenheiros se concentrem em atividades de maior valor agregado.

  • Graduação em Engenharia (Mecânica, Química, de Alimentos, de Produção, ou áreas correlatas).

  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de engenharia, preferencialmente em indústrias de alimentos, bebidas, farmacêutica ou química.

Nós os ajudamos a reinventar a maneira como os profissionais trabalham, nossa equipe de especialistas reúne informação, inovação e insight para desvendar situações complexas nos mercados Tributário, Comércio Exterior, contábil e Jurídico, respaldando nossos clientes na tomada de decisão.

Nesta oportunidade, como Analista de Suporte - Folha de Pagamento , você será responsável por oferecer um atendimento técnico de excelência aos clientes que utilizam os módulos de Folha de Pagamento do sistema Domínio. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:

A Thomson Reuters informa o caminho adiante ao reunir conteúdo confiável e a tecnologia que pessoas e organizações precisam para tomar decisões corretas. Servimos profissionais nos setores jurídico, fiscal, contábil, de conformidade, governamental e de mídia. Nossos produtos combinam software altamente especializado e informações para capacitar profissionais com dados, inteligência e soluções para decisões informadas. A Reuters, parte da Thomson Reuters, é líder mundial em jornalismo e notícias confiáveis. title: Senior Systems Analyst (IBM Power Systems)
description:
Role and Responsibilities

  • Interact with Global Managed Services (GMS) customers daily in support of the environments managed by GMS – hosted or remote by
    • Resolving environment-related problems reported by GMS customers through CSS as assigned
    • Completing service requests submitted by GMS customers, including managing customer user IDs, remote print writers and/or queues, and similar requests
    • Submitting service requests for data center services needed by GMS customers
    • Acting as a liaison between GMS customer and Netcracker IT Group to facilitate the completion of requests
    • Researching system and database journals to retrieve auditing information in support of internal and customer data investigations
    • Troubleshooting problems with TCP/IP-based interfaces using IBM and third-party network tracing tools
  • Configure and monitor systems to ensure
    • peak and problem-free operation
    • compliance with security standards
  • Configure and support
    • Software-based replication, particularly using Vision Solutions MIMIX HA1, as it relates to both HA and DR implementations.
    • System monitoring, particularly using Help Systems Halcyon, especially as it relates to interface/job monitoring
    • Tape management systems, particularly using IBM’s BRMS.
    • System compliance and audit functions, particularly using Enforcive Enterprise Security, especially as it relates to PCI compliance
    • Automation functions, particularly using Help Systems Robot SCHEDULE and REPLAY, or IBM’s Advanced Job Scheduler
    • Browser-based GUI interface, particularly using Rocket Software’s LegaSuite application over Netcracker’s ICOMS solution.
    • Digital certificates using IBM Digital Certificate Manager
    • End user access to system tools using IBM i Navigator
  • Maintain application environments by
    • Reviewing patches and release updates and constructing a plan to apply them to Netcracker and third party applications
    • Creating custom programming using CL, RPG, or other available languages in support of production processing
    • Performing regular maintenance tasks on time to ensure PCI compliance
  • Regularly review
    • Security bulletins issued by US-CERT, IBM, and other vendors, especially related to PCI compliance. Resolve any vulnerabilities on time
    • System performance statistics, forecasted growth data, and project system resource utilization, making recommendations for hardware and/or software upgrades to meet demand.
    • Disaster Recovery Plans and participate in annual Disaster Recovery Exercises, focusing on validating business continuity plans for GMS customers. Update the DR plans to reflect current configurations, environments, and processes.
  • Manage the underlying systems supporting the ICOMS solution by
    • Upgrading firmware, and HMC release levels in accordance with IBM compatibility matrices and recommendations
    • Allocating system resources for production and test partitions
    • Preparing system plans for partitions on Power Systems servers
    • Installing hardware components required by the solution
    • Reading the PAL and SAL in System Service Tools (SST) and Service logs in the HMC to assist hardware maintenance providers with troubleshooting, and resolving hardware problems.
  • Will be asked to perform similar duties for internal (development/test) systems as well.
  • May be asked to perform consulting services for customers outside of GMS

Required Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years experience (preferably more) administering IBM i running on Power Systems servers.
    • Must be familiar with all aspects of system administration, including upgrades from previous releases, backup and recovery, storage management, using journaling, understands the differences between various types of ASPs and their uses, and has strong HMC skills.
  • IBM Certified System Administrator - IBM i 7.x (highly preferred)
  • At least one major system hardware upgrade (for example POWER6 to POWER7)
  • At least two major operating system upgrades (for example, IBM i 5.4 or 6.1 to 7.1)
  • At least two full system restores (as if from a site-down crash)
  • Experience in managing partitioned systems
  • Strong experience in using database journaling, especially remote journaling
  • Strong experience with utilizing Performance tools such as IBM Job Watcher/Pex and MPG Performance Navigator
  • Understands the differences between independent ASPs, *SYSBAS, and traditional ASPs
  • Understands the functional differences between logical replication and clustering
  • Understands IBM i security administration, compliance, and access control
  • Extensive knowledge of the HMC
  • Some experience managing IBM i with SAN-attached storage
  • Keeps up with IBM hardware announcements, and has an awareness of IBM technical directions for their product lines
  • Keeps up with Technology Refreshes, and has an awareness of new features and functions
  • Is very familiar with the IBM Memo to Users for V7R1 as of April 2012, and any subsequent Technical Releases (TRs)
  • Ability to train operations monitoring staff on how to respond to alerts, ensure “switch readiness” on HA/DR systems, and perform less complex maintenance window activities
  • Must be able to provide 24x7 on-call support coverage - on a rotational basis with other team members. (on occasion)

Other Highly Desired Skills

  • Experience installing software upgrades and updates to third party and in-house developed applications
  • Very familiar with the use of MIMIX software for logical replication of database information to redundant systems for high availability and disaster recovery deployments
  • Very familiar with the configuration and management of ODBC / JDBC / TCP socket communications on IBM i systems communicating with other applications running on Unix / Linux & or Windows systems
  • Very familiar with current PCI-DSS standards and how to ensure PCI compliance on IBM i operating system and database containing PCI sensitive data
  • Experience managing medium projects, lasting a few weeks, involving two or more teams.
  • Fluent English Speaker and availability to work from office on Hybrid mode
  • Must be able to work on Shifts mode

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field

Nossa Equipe: O time de Planejamento Estratégico tem como missão transformar dados e análises em decisões que impulsionem o crescimento da empresa. Atua de forma transversal com diversas áreas, estruturando metas, indicadores e processos comerciais para garantir previsibilidade, eficiência e foco em resultados. É um ambiente dinâmico, analítico e colaborativo, ideal para quem gosta de entender o negócio em profundidade, conectar estratégia e execução e gerar impacto real por meio de análises financeiras e comerciais.

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional para integrar nosso time de Planejamento Estratégico. Se você é apaixonado(a) por análise de dados, estratégia e finanças, e possui sólida experiência em transformar informações em direcionamentos práticos para o negócio, esta posição é para você. Aqui, você terá papel fundamental na conexão entre resultados comerciais e financeiros , atuando como parceiro(a) estratégico(a) da liderança. Além de apoiar na definição de metas e estratégias comerciais, esperamos que este(a) profissional tenha profundo entendimento de P&L (DRE) , saiba avaliar impacto de receitas, custos e despesas, e contribua ativamente para o aumento da rentabilidade e da margem do negócio .

  • Apoiar iniciativas de melhoria contínua e automação de processos da área de planejamento.

description:
AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the job

The Product Manager for BEES Deliver will play a pivotal role in driving the product evolution and development of our logistics digital transformation solution. This role involves leading cross-functional teams to enhance product features, optimize connectivity with the BEES ecosystem, and ensure a seamless delivery experience for our global customers. The Product Manager will be responsible for structuring the core journey of BEES Deliver to become a global product and expand its reach with minimal customizations.

What you'll do:

  • Guide Product Discoveries: Collaborate with engineering, UX/UI, sales, and logistics teams to define the users’ problems to be solved and how to find optimal solutions for them, transforming this into product evolution requirements.
  • Define Requirements: Create high-level requirements to document all findings and definitions from the discovery phase.
  • Epics creation and management: Create epics and manage the Epic board, including detailing, status updates, and identifying affected countries.
  • User Stories Creation: Write and manage User Stories, ensuring they are well-defined, with adequate acceptance criteria, and aligned with the product vision.
  • Lead execution of the product roadmap, ensuring alignment with business goals and customer needs.
  • User Research: Collaborate with UX Research to align research materials, scripts, and scopes to gain insights into user behavior.
  • Prototype Development: Partner with Product Design to support them in the creation of effective prototypes.
  • Architectural Planning: Work with Architects to support them in the creation of the architecture solution for new initiatives and map out dependencies.
  • Tracking Plan: Collaborate with the Data Team to establish a segment tracking plan.
  • Measure Hypothesis: Monitor product performance and customer feedback, using data-driven insights to inform decision-making.
  • Manage project timelines and resources to ensure timely delivery of product milestones.

What you'll need:

  • Experience as a Product Manager in an e-commerce, logistics or tech environment.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams.
  • Ability to think strategically and execute methodically.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make informed decisions.
  • Familiarity with software development methodologies and tools such as Mixpanel and JIRA.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global environment, and adapt to changing priorities.

More about you:

  • You´re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You´re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You´re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance

title: Experienced UVM Verification Engineer
description:
Are you willing to participate in the development of a human size growing team?

Aedvices specializes in ICs, FPGAs and embedded systems Front-End Digital Design and Design Verification. We provide flexible solutions to our customers, ranging from turnkey design and verification options to dedicated consulting in design or verification as well as training solutions.

Our customer base spans from large semiconductor groups to small tech startups.

We support a wide range of projects in the automotive, big-data, artificial intelligence and energy sectors, such as the verification of the telemetry system of a Mars probe / Mars tremors or the verification of a System-on-Chip for Bluetooth Low Energy.

To sustain our growth, we are looking for several experienced verification engineers to join the team.

Your main responsibilities

As a key member of the verification team, you will define the verification methodologies and adapt them to the project requirements. You will be responsible for the verification of complex IPs and System-On-Chips, the development of verification environments (SystemVerilog/UVM/other), UVM verification IPs (VIPs), and the writing of verification plans.

You propose improvements to existing flows. You will also have the opportunity to work with colleagues in France and with our partners on innovative approaches and methodologies (formal methods, PSS).

Is the job right for you?

To carry out your missions, you need to master several essential technical topics:

  • Functional verification at IP level and of complex SoC,
  • SystemVerilog testbench and UVM core development,
  • Development of verification plans,
  • AMBA protocols,
  • Embedded software development (C, C++),
  • Knowledge of RTL design languages: VHDL, Verilog,
  • Written and spoken English.

Other skills welcome:

  • Object Oriented Programming,
  • Advanced protocols such as PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, Bluetooth, …
  • ASIC and FPGA design,
  • Scripting (Python).

For an efficient and fruitful collaboration, we expect you to:

  • Have an engineering background or equivalent, and at least 5 years’ experience in verification,
  • Be able to balance perfectionism and pragmatism!
  • Be eager to learn new things, grow your skills and elaborate creative technical solutions,
  • Be able to work in a team,
  • Think “problem solving” and think “out of the box”,
  • And last but not least: be committed to customers’ satisfaction.

What we offer you

  • Continue to develop your expertise with the access of all our training materials,
  • Join a friendly company who share values of Diversity, Conviviality, Technical Expertise and Passion,
  • Benefit from a flexible organization with the possibility of remote work,
  • Full time contract,
  • Additional benefits such as meal voucher and dental health.

Want to join us?

Our recruitment process is simple:

After an initial call, you’ll meet with Agnès, our HR Manager, and Eric, our Verification Technical Director.

If your expectations match ours, the recruitment process concludes with a meeting with Fabio, our Brazil director.

More about you:



  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Storytelling mindset, connecting data insights to business impact in a compelling way.

  • Proactive and solution-oriented attitude, anticipating needs and suggesting improvements.

  • Collaborative approach, working effectively with cross-functional and international teams while building trust and alignment.

  • Detail-oriented, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and high-quality standards in all deliverables.

  • Adaptable and resilient, comfortable managing tight deadlines and shifting priorities.

title: Junior Product Manager Software
description:
Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you’re interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Torizon is a Linux-based industrial IoT platform that simplifies modern iterative development, maintenance, and operation of distributed edge devices. It is a scalable full-stack DevOps-oriented solution, seamlessly integrating device hardware & software (including a Linux OS), development tools, cloud-based remote updates & fleet management, for high reliability and security applications.

Job Description

As a Junior Product Manager – Software , you will be part of the Product & Technology ( P&T ) group, supporting the definition and execution of the product vision for Toradex’s software stack — from embedded Linux to cloud-based tools. You will work closely with senior PMS, engineering, marketing, and customer-facing teams to help ensure our software offerings deliver value and align with customer and market needs.

This role is ideal for someone early in their product management career who wants to grow into a strong, technical product leader. You’ll learn how to balance strategy and execution, and gain hands-on experience with embedded and IoT technologies.

  • Support senior Product Managers in defining and maintaining the product roadmap.
  • Participate in market research, competitive analysis, and customer interviews.
  • Translate customer and business needs into product requirements and user stories.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams during planning, development, and release cycles.
  • Help coordinate software release notes, documentation, and internal product communication.
  • Track and analyze product KPIs, usage data, and customer feedback.
  • Contribute to improving product management processes and tools.

Desired Candidate Profile

Mandatory:

  • Proactive attitude and willingness to learn.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
  • Basic understanding of software development processes or lifecycle.
  • Analytical thinking and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional, multicultural teams.
  • Previous experience (internship, trainee, or 1–2 years) in product management, software development, or related roles.

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with Agile or Scrum practices.
  • Understanding of embedded systems, Linux, or IoT technologies.
  • Understanding of Software as a Service (SaaS) technologies.
  • Experience working with developer tools, issue trackers (e.g., Jira), or analytics dashboards.

Willing to learn:

  • Product management techniques and tools, including helping the PM Team with their implementation.
  • Business and technical aspects of embedded Linux and cloud-connected devices.
  • Data-driven decision-making for software products.
  • Communication with stakeholders across technical and non-technical domains.

What we offer

  • Agile, globally oriented, and inter-cultural corporate culture.
  • Exposure to leading-edge embedded and IoT technologies.
  • Flat hierarchy where you can shape and influence your work processes.
  • Mentorship and learning opportunities from experienced Product Managers and engineers.
  • Variety of knowledge-sharing, training, and self-development opportunities.
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space, and a flexible working environment.
  • Opportunities for career growth into more senior Product Management roles.
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

title: Product Security Engineer
description:
Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you’re interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Overview

As a Product Security Engineer at Toradex, you’ll be responsible for the implementation, validation, and maintenance of security features in Toradex’s embedded software stack. That means hands‑on, low‑level work with bootloaders, Linux kernel security features, secure software updates and more.

We aim to make embedded software development easy and approachable, which means that our engineers have to go beyond just feature enablement. Your work will involve making the developer experience of working with low‑level security features as smooth as it possibly can be. You’ll work on systems used in critical industries like healthcare, industrial automation, and robotics.

Responsibilities

  • Security feature enablement: Bring up security features on new hardware. Every new product we release, we strive to have a uniform, straightforward experience for enabling basic hardware security features like secure boot, ARM TrustZone/ OP-TEE , and hardware‑backed encryption.
  • System-level hardening: Toradex maintains Torizon OS, a secure, production‑ready embedded Linux OS. Making sure that security features fit into the whole stack, and that configurations are secure‑by‑default for the most common and supported workflows is a key part of the job. Understanding how everything fits together is a must.
  • Vulnerability management: Monitor upstream CVEs, assess their impact on Toradex products and their likely impact on Toradex customers' products. Apply patches and mitigations. Help draft security advisories and write VEX documents. Work on and maintain internal tooling for vulnerability management.
  • Security testing and automation: Automate test coverage of security features. Familiarity with LAVA or other hardware‑in‑the‑loop embedded testing methodologies and frameworks is a strong plus.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of experience in embedded systems security or adjacent areas (e.g. Linux security engineering)
  • Hands‑on experience with bootloaders (e.g., U-Boot), kernel security features, and embedded Linux distributions/build systems (Yocto/OpenEmbedded, buildroot, etc.)
  • Solid C/C++ coding and debugging skills
  • Experience with automating security checks in CI/CD pipelines
  • Knowledge of threat modeling/risk modeling methodologies and how they relate to regulatory and standards compliance is a plus
  • Knowledge of security evaluation and analysis tools like fuzzers and static analysis tools is a plus

What we offer

  • Agile, globally oriented and intercultural corporate culture.
  • Work on the latest hardware technology with early access to major SoC vendor
  • Enjoy a flat hierarchy where you may truly shape our hardware and software offerings
  • Count on a diverse team of experienced hardware and software engineers
  • Variety of knowledge sharing, training and self‑development opportunities
  • The opportunity to play a key role in shaping your own work processes and your work environment.
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment.
  • Opportunities for your personal development.
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature‑rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self‑driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

title: Arquiteto de Engenharia de Software
description:
Overview

Fazemos parte do Grupo BTG Pactual, maior banco de investimento da américa latina. Nosso propósito é transformar ativos desvalorizados no mercado de crédito e real estate. Atuamos na gestão de créditos inadimplentes corporativos, ajudando fundos, investidores, instituições financeiras e empresas a encontrarem soluções estratégicas para seus negócios. Isso é possível, devido às nossas 4 verticais: Créditos Inadimplidos Coorporativos (NPL), Ativos Imobiliários Estressados (DRE), Recuperação Judicial e Falência e Dívida Ativa.

Principais destaques

Alguns dos nossos destaques:

  • Somos um dos maiores resultados do Grupo BTG Pactual.
  • Crescemos, em média, 20% ao ano.
  • Contamos com a ATENA, nossa IA que otimiza a rotina e potencializa análises.

Nossa comunidade é formada por 300 colaboradores e 170 parceiros, que atuam com proatividade, inovação, excelência, senso de dono e foco no cliente. Em um ambiente que valoriza o empreendedorismo, a meritocracia e o foco no cliente, promovemos uma cultura de resultados e crescimento profissional contínuo.

Utilizamos banco de dados PostgreSQL e com micro serviços desenvolvidos em Python (flask) e frontend em Angular. Toda nossa estrutura é “dockerizada” rodando em kubernetes e integrada utilizando tópicos (SNS) e filas (SQS). Também fazemos uso do Elasticsearch para otimizar nossas consultas. Tudo sendo provido pela AWS. Também temos toda uma esteira de CI/CD com testes automatizados provido pela Microsoft Azure Devops.

Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter microsserviços em Python (Flask ou FastAPI), garantindo alta performance, segurança e escalabilidade;
  • Contribuir para a arquitetura técnica e para o desenho de soluções que traduzam demandas de negócio em sistemas robustos e eficientes;
  • Implantar integrações e automações utilizando o ecossistema AWS (EventBridge, SQS, RDS, Lambda, S3, entre outros);
  • Atuar na observabilidade e sustentação de aplicações em ambiente Kubernetes, com foco em confiabilidade e resiliência;
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (produto, dados e negócios) para evoluir continuamente a plataforma tecnológica da Enforce;
  • Participar ativamente de decisões técnicas e estratégicas de arquitetura e infraestrutura.

Requisitos

  • +8 anos de experiência em engenharia de software, utilizamos Python e frameworks modernos (Flask, FastAPI ou similares) mas caso você venha do Java e tenha desejo de trabalhar com nossa stack não será problema;
  • Vivência em ambientes baseados em microsserviços e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Experiência sólida com AWS (preferencialmente EventBridge, SQS, Lambda, RDS e S3);
  • Conhecimentos em orquestração de containers com Kubernetes;
  • Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas de alta qualidade;
  • Perfil colaborativo, com iniciativa e foco em resultados.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em sistemas financeiros, gestão de crédito ou recuperação de ativos;
  • Conhecimento em pipelines de dados e automação de processos complexos;
  • Familiaridade com práticas DevOps e CI/CD.
  • Plano Médico e Odontológico Bradesco;
  • Cartão Flash (VA/VR e auxílio flexível);
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados anual;
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass );
  • Programa de Capacitação (Auxílio educação);

Aqui, o aprendizado é constante: a cada novo ativo adquirido, você estará imerso em um processo dinâmico de identificação de problemas e criação de estratégias eficazes. Aqui você terá a oportunidade de transformar mercados, impulsionar grandes projetos e crescer profissionalmente em um ambiente enérgico e colaborativo.

Informações Adicionais / O que esperamos de você:

  • Capacidade Técnica: Conhecimento da estrutura regulatória do setor elétrico e suas alterações, com foco nas regras de comercialização de energia no Brasil.
  • Análise Crítica: Habilidade para identificar riscos e oportunidades de negócios a partir das mudanças regulatórias, propondo e negociando melhorias na regulação do setor elétrico e nas regras de comercialização de energia.
  • Comunicação Eficaz: Competência para acompanhar publicações relevantes no DOU e pautas regulatórias nas Reuniões da Diretoria da ANEEL, além de representar os negócios não regulados do Grupo CPFL junto às autoridades competentes e associações de agentes de mercado.
  • Colaboração e Influência: Capacidade de suportar a construção de contribuições às consultas públicas, tomadas de subsídios e demais atos regulatórios relacionados ao Setor Elétrico, interagindo com a Diretoria Executiva do grupo CPFL e áreas internas clientes.
  • Proatividade e Inovação: Elaboração de estudos e pareceres regulatórios para diversas áreas dos negócios não regulados, clientes, fornecedores e públicos diversos, sempre buscando maximizar o resultado consolidado do Grupo CPFL.

O que oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;

Conheça um pouco sobre nós:

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

description:
Overview

Em 2017, a Companhia deu início à sua trajetória de investimentos com a aquisição do Hospital Vera Cruz, localizado em Campinas-SP. Com mais de 80 anos de história, o hospital é um dos mais tradicionais da cidade. Atualmente, o Hospital Vera Cruz conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 120 leitos de internação, 30 leitos de UTI, maternidade e pronto atendimento 24h. Além disso, oferece atendimento em mais de 66 especialidades médicas e possui Acreditação ONA 3, estando em processo de preparação para a certificação JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Hospital Vera Cruz, expandimos significativamente nossa rede em Campinas e região. Isso inclui a inauguração de novos serviços, como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia e a Unidade de Atenção Primária à Saúde, além da criação de unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba. Também adquirimos a Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais emblemáticos da cidade, instalado em um prédio centenário que faz parte do patrimônio particular local. No mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2care. Essas aquisições reforçam as consolidações da nossa região, que fazem parte do grupo Hospital Care. Fundado em 2017, o Hospital Care nasceu da união de pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar no Brasil. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde, com um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, focado no equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Nosso sistema de saúde é completo, com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia, estamos presentes em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais de gestão de saúde, nos estados de São Paulo, Paraná e Santa Catarina. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos consolidar como a principal Rede de Prestadores de Serviços de Saúde do Brasil.

Company Overview

BotCity is building the future of automation with the Governance Platform for Python automations and AI Agents. Our philosophy is simple: automation is software, and software deserves the same high-code standards that drive innovation in AI and machine learning.

We recently raised a $12M Series A, led by Four Rivers with participation from Y Combinator, SoftBank, and top industry leaders such as Lew Cirne (New Relic), Rod Johnson (Spring Source), and Walter Kortschak (Summit Partners | Firestreak Ventures). With 1,000+ customers in 70+ countries, including Bayer and LG, and recognition by G2 (2024) as one of the world’s top 25 emerging platforms, BotCity is scaling fast.

We’re a global remote company with teams across the US and LATAM, united by a shared vision to redefine how enterprises build and manage automation. If you’re looking for an environment that values impact, autonomy, and excellence, we’d love for you to join us on this journey.

Role Overview

The ITOps Analyst will handle all IT operational needs at BotCity (excluding product, engineering, and InfoSec), covering tasks from user provisioning to device management to infrastructure support. This role is crucial to ensuring that internal teams (sales, ops, marketing, etc.) can operate without IT friction or downtime. The ideal person is a hands‑on problem‑solver with strong ownership, technical versatility, and good communication.

Responsibilities

  • Manage user lifecycle, including provisioning, de‑provisioning, access controls, and permissions across systems (G Suite, Office 365, Slack, internal tools).
  • Oversee hardware and software asset inventory, including acquisitions, deployments, refresh cycles, warranties.
  • Set up, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot workstations, peripherals, mobile devices, VPNs, and basic network connectivity.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve user IT tickets (desktop, laptop, OS, connectivity, software) promptly.
  • Coordinate with vendors for support, maintenance, and procurement (SaaS tools, licensing).
  • Create, maintain and enforce internal IT policies and standards (passwords, device encryption, backup, patching).
  • Support onboarding and off‑boarding processes with IT compliance (access removal, exit checklist).
  • Monitor and manage internal systems (file shares, backup, printers, internal tools) and alert on issues.
  • Create and maintain documentation of IT processes, configurations, user guides, policies.
  • Assist with small infrastructure projects (office moves, network upgrades, software rollouts).
  • Escalate and coordinate with Engineering and Security teams when needed (e.g. deeper system issues).

Required Qualifications

  • Technical diploma in Information Systems, Systems Analysis or related degree.
  • Experience (3+ years) in an IT support, systems, or operations role (generalist).
  • Strong experience with user and access management systems (e.g. Google Workspace, SSO, IAM).

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in media buying (paid social, programmatic, search, or video) and a deep understanding of ad serving, tracking, and campaign troubleshooting. You will bridge the gap between media execution and technical ad ops, ensuring seamless campaign delivery and maximizing ROI.

  • Client & Stakeholder Success: Act as a trusted advisor to internal teams or clients on best practices.

  • Sales Acumen - Skills to pitch ad solutions effectively, negotiate deals, and close partnerships with publishers or advertisers.

  • Resilience - Ability to handle challenges and setbacks while maintaining motivation and a positive attitude.
  • Data Visualization - Skills to create clear and impactful reports or dashboards to communicate performance and insights effectively.
  • AI Fluency - Understanding and practical application of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, data enrichment tools, automated workflows) to enhance productivity, decision-making, and campaign performance.

Senior Product Designer – Shopping Journey

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Designer (Senior) to join our Shopping Journey team. You’ll be responsible for designing user-centered experiences that drive real impact across the shopping experience, from discovery to post-sales. If you enjoy thinking strategically, creating scalable solutions, and collaborating with other designers to deliver simple, efficient, and inclusive experiences, this role is for you. You’ll work closely with experienced designers in an agile environment, with room to propose, test, and deliver solutions at scale.

What you'll do:

  • Lead end-to-end design processes, from discovery through delivery.
  • Map and design journeys within the shopping ecosystem, focusing on usability, clarity, and conversion.
  • Create flows, prototypes, and interfaces based on data, research, and usability best practices, drawing from sources like Baymard Institute and Nielsen Norman Group.
  • Participate and lead discovery workshops and co-creation dynamics to map opportunities and prioritize solutions.
  • Support definition of success metrics and hypothesis validation.
  • Collaborate with UX Writing, UX Research, Product, and Engineering to ensure cohesive solutions.
  • Defend design decisions using strong rationale grounded in user needs and business impact.
  • Contribute to and evolve the design system with scalable, consistent, and accessible components.
  • Take part in design rituals like critiques, reviews, and feedback sessions.

What you'll need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Graphic Design, Digital Design, Visual Design, Product Design, or Industrial Design.
  • Hands-on experience as a Product Designer delivering end-to-end digital products (web and/or mobile).
  • Solid understanding of UX, UI, prototyping, and usability best practices.
  • Proficiency with Figma and familiarity with tools like Lucidchart, Maze, or similar.
  • Ability to clearly articulate and defend design decisions using data, benchmarks, and empathy for diverse audiences.
  • Experience working in agile environments, collaborating with Product, Engineering, and other Designers.
  • Advanced English for documentation and occasional global collaboration.
  • Experience in B2B, marketplace, e-commerce, or large-scale platforms.

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with discovery frameworks, product metrics, and A/B testing.
  • Knowledge of accessibility and inclusive design principles.

More about you:

  • A curious mindset and investigative approach to deeply understand problems before solving them.
  • Clear and effective communication across different formats and audiences.
  • Proactive attitude to suggest improvements, test ideas, and learn from outcomes.
  • Genuine collaboration with active listening and respect for diverse perspectives.
  • Attention to visual consistency and detail, with ownership of the impact delivered.
  • Interest in growing within a team that values excellence, autonomy, and continuous learning.

  • Performance based bonus*
